description: Responsive card grid for discrete content objects — posts, features, team members. Not for decorative icon grids. Cards are 1-col mobile, 2-col tablet, 3-col desktop.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Section heading above the grid. Omit if the context makes it clear. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

title_accent.description: Optional exact substring of title to render in an accent color. Must match title exactly (case-sensitive) or it is ignored.

eyebrow.description: Optional short kicker/label rendered as a pill above the title. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

subheading.description: Optional supporting line below the title. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

title_align.description: Alignment of the eyebrow/title/subheading header block. 'start' = left-aligned (default, unchanged historical behavior). 'center' = centered.

layout.description: Structural layout. 'cards' = standard card grid. 'steps' = numbered process cards with visual connectors at desktop. Use 'steps' for How-it-works / process flows.

card_emphasis.description: Whether the first card gets the emphasized 'featured' treatment (accent top bar, tinted fill, larger title, extra top padding, and — on the muted theme — a lift). 'featured' (default, unchanged historical behavior) emphasizes the first card, drawing the eye to a lead item. 'uniform' renders every card identically — use it for a symmetric/peer card row where all cards are equal (e.g. three specification cards whose checklists must line up, or an equal-weight feature/plan row). Cards-layout concept: it has NO VISUAL EFFECT on 'steps', because every featured rule is scoped :not(.grid--steps). The grid--uniform class is still EMITTED on steps markup — that is deliberate, so a future steps-specific first-card emphasis could be guarded with the same hook — so do not read the class's presence as evidence the treatment applied.

theme.description: Background color/tone for this band. 'default' = the band's own default background (no tone override). 'muted' = light tinted surface band (renders the --color-surface background with framing top and bottom borders). 'inverted' = inverted dark background for strong contrast; use 'inverted' for a genuinely dark band.

columns.description: Optional explicit desktop (>=768px) column count, an integer 1-4. Unset (key absent, null, or empty) keeps the default auto-derivation from item count (unchanged, byte-identical). When set it forces that many equal-width columns at >=768px, spanning the container, overriding the item-count grain; the single-column collapse below 768px is unchanged. Out-of-range or non-integer values (0, 5, 2.5, text) are rejected, not clamped. Cards-layout concept; ignored on 'steps' (which keeps its fixed process grain). Set with create_page / update_component, not style_component.

image_treatment.description: How each card's image_url renders. 'banner' (default, unchanged historical behavior) is a full-width 16:9 cover banner above the card body. 'icon' renders the image at a small fixed icon size (the --grid-item-icon-size slot, default 48px) above the title, un-cropped (object-fit: contain) — for icon+title+text feature cards where a ~45px logo/glyph would otherwise be blown up into a cropped banner. Unset keeps 'banner' (byte-identical). Invalid values are rejected with the standard invalid_prop_value envelope (closed set: banner|icon), not silently coerced. Cards-layout concept; ignored on 'steps' (which renders no item images). Set with create_page / update_component, not style_component.

items.description: Array of card items. Each: { title, text, bullets, image_url, image_alt, image_id, link_url, link_text }. When layout is 'steps', also include: { number }.

number.description: Step number label (e.g. '1', '01', '1.'). Required when grid layout is 'steps'.

title.description: Card heading. Plain text — HTML is escaped.

text.description: Card body / supporting text. Inline HTML allowed: a, strong, em, br.

text_role.description: Optional typography role for the card text: 'mono' (code), 'meta' (captions), 'label', or 'kicker' (eyebrow). Adds a .text-<role> class. Unset (key absent, null, or empty) → default body text; a value outside the set is rejected at write. Set via update_component. 'meta'/'kicker' also set a preset text color; an explicit --grid-item-text-color style slot overrides that preset color at ALL breakpoints (the explicit slot always wins), while the role's size/weight/letter-spacing/transform still apply.

bullets.description: Optional checklist lines rendered below text, each prefixed with a check mark. Plain text only — no HTML/markdown; each line is escaped independently. Use for scannable feature/benefit lists instead of cramming items into one text sentence.

image_alt.description: Alt text for the card image. Leave empty only if the image is purely decorative.

image_id.description: Media Library attachment ID (NOT a URL). When it resolves to a real attachment, the image renders responsively with srcset/sizes via wp_get_attachment_image() instead of a single fixed-size . Falls back to image_url when unset or unresolvable. Get an attachment id via the import_media apply.

link_url.description: Optional card link destination. Accepts an absolute URL, a site-relative /path, an #anchor, mailto:, or tel:; a disallowed protocol (javascript:, data:) is rejected at write time.

style.description: Optional per-card style overrides for THIS card only (issue 306). Accepts ONLY the CARD-SCOPED style slots — the ones flagged item_eligible in styling.style_slots because they are consumed on the .grid__item and its contents (issue 323): --grid-item-bg, --grid-item-border-color, --grid-item-border-width, --grid-item-radius, --grid-item-shadow, --grid-item-bar-color, --grid-item-bar-height, --grid-featured-texture-color, --grid-featured-shadow, --grid-item-padding, --grid-item-gap, --grid-item-text-align, --grid-item-icon-size, --grid-item-title-size, --grid-item-title-color, --grid-item-text-color, --grid-item-bullet-color, --grid-item-link-color, --grid-item-link-hover-color, --grid-step-bg, --grid-step-text-color. Validated by the shared style engine exactly like grid-level slots (unknown slot names and invalid values are rejected). Rendered as inline custom properties on this card's .grid__item, so a per-card slot overrides the grid-level value by cascade proximity. Container/heading slots (--grid-bg, --grid-gap, --grid-heading-*, --grid-heading-accent-color, --grid-eyebrow-*, --grid-subheading-*, --grid-padding-*) are read on the section/list/header, not the card, so a per-card override would render nothing — they are REJECTED here with invalid_style_slot naming the card; set those on the grid-level style instead. Use per-card style for one distinct card in a row: a dark CTA panel beside light checklist cards, or a green-on-dark terminal card. Set via the composition (update_component / update_composition / create_page), not style_component (which is component-scoped).

--grid-padding-top.description: Top padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm (fluid ~68-80px desktop, ~54px mobile); set an explicit length to override.

--grid-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm; set an explicit length to override.

--grid-heading-color.description: Heading text color. Defaults to the theme text colour (the inverted variant supplies its own light default). LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ: recolouring every heading on the site is ONE update_design_token write on --color-text, not one slot write per band.

--grid-heading-accent-color.description: Color of the title_accent substring within the heading. Ignored unless title_accent is set AND occurs as a substring of title — no accent span is rendered otherwise, so this slot has nothing to colour.

--grid-eyebrow-radius.description: Eyebrow pill corner radius. Set a large value (e.g. 999px) for a fully rounded pill.

--grid-eyebrow-border-width.description: Eyebrow pill border width. Set a non-zero width (with --grid-eyebrow-border-color) for an outlined pill; 0 (default) renders no border.

--grid-eyebrow-border-color.description: Eyebrow pill border color. Takes effect when --grid-eyebrow-border-width is non-zero.

--grid-eyebrow-text-transform.description: Eyebrow pill letter-casing. Default uppercase renders the kicker in caps; set none to keep it as authored (e.g. sentence case), or lowercase / capitalize.

--grid-subheading-margin-bottom.description: Space between the subheading and the content below it

--grid-heading-margin-bottom.description: Space between the heading and the subheading below it. 1.65rem is the effective default at desktop (>=768px); below 768px it is 1.25rem.

--grid-heading-size.description: Heading font size. Defaults to the shared responsive band-heading scale (fluid ~28px mobile to ~42px desktop), which every band heading in the theme routes. LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ from the rest of the site: retuning every band heading at once is ONE update_design_token write on --pp-band-heading-size, not one slot write per band.

--grid-heading-measure.description: Maximum width of the grid heading — increase to let a long heading use the available horizontal space. Routes the shared --measure-heading design token (40rem) by default, so retuning that ONE token changes every routed band heading at once; set a length here only when THIS band must differ from the rest of the site.

--grid-gap.description: Gap between grid cards. DUAL JOB: on the steps layout SETTING it also sets the LENGTH of the connector line drawn between consecutive step badges at >=1024px, so widening the gap lengthens the connector and there is no separate connector-length slot. The coupling is set-only: UNSET, the connector takes its own var(--space-lg) fallback rather than the composed-page gap literal, so the two are not equal until you write this slot. 1rem is the effective default on a composed page (1.05rem at >=1024px, 0.85rem below 768px).

--grid-item-bg.description: Card background color or gradient. The stated gradient is the effective default on a composed page for the standard cards; the FEATURED first card defaults to an accent gradient instead, an inverted grid defaults its cards to var(--color-bg) so they stay light on a dark band, and a steps card falls back to var(--color-surface). Setting this replaces the fill layer on every card it applies to; the decorative texture stripe above it is a separate layer and stays

--grid-item-border-color.description: Card border color. DUAL JOB: on the steps layout it ALSO colours the connector line between step badges at >=1024px, so recolouring the card border recolours the connector with it. The featured first card overrides this with its own accent border unless you set this slot.

--grid-item-radius.description: Card border radius. 4px on a composed page, at every viewport.

--grid-item-shadow.description: Card box shadow / glow (preset var(--shadow-sm|md|lg) or a bounded box-shadow). The stated value is the effective default on a composed page; the featured first card carries its own blue glow instead, via --grid-featured-shadow.

--grid-item-bar-color.description: Card top-bar color or gradient (cards layout only; no bar exists on steps). The featured first card defaults to an accent gradient; setting this slot pins one bar color on every card
--grid-item-bar-color.conditionality_note: the component sits at the top level of a composed page — these rules are scoped `main > .grid`, a composed-page context the clause grammar cannot express

--grid-item-bar-height.description: Card top-bar height (cards layout only; the featured first card defaults to 4px). 0 removes the bar on every card
--grid-item-bar-height.conditionality_note: the component sits at the top level of a composed page — these rules are scoped `main > .grid`, a composed-page context the clause grammar cannot express

--grid-featured-texture-color.description: Texture-stripe line color painted on the featured first card only (cards layout on composed pages). transparent removes the stripe. The stripe's COLOUR is what this slot reaches; its repeat PERIOD (2.75rem on the featured card, 3rem on the non-featured ones) is a stated default with no slot — the period is what makes the pattern read as texture rather than as ruled lines, and it is not a value composed from content. See components/grid/README.md, 'Stated defaults'
--grid-featured-texture-color.conditionality_note: the component sits at the top level of a composed page — these rules are scoped `main > .grid`, a composed-page context the clause grammar cannot express, and it paints the FIRST card only

--grid-featured-shadow.description: Box shadow of the featured first card only (cards layout on composed pages); overrides the shared --grid-item-shadow there. When both are unset a built-in blue glow renders. Set none (or set --grid-item-shadow for all cards) to remove the featured glow
--grid-featured-shadow.conditionality_note: the component sits at the top level of a composed page — these rules are scoped `main > .grid`, a composed-page context the clause grammar cannot express, and it paints the FIRST card only

--grid-item-padding.description: Card body padding. 2rem is the effective default at desktop (>=768px) on a composed page; below 768px it is 1.55rem, and the featured first card takes 2.25rem of top padding at >=1024px.

--grid-item-text-align.description: Alignment of the card's content within the card body. 'left' (default) is unchanged historical behavior; 'center' centers the content (use for centered emoji/label contact cards); also accepts 'right', 'start', 'end', 'justify'. Governs BOTH the text (title, text, bullets) via text-align AND the 'Read more' link/button, which follows the same alignment via the derived --pp-grid-link-align companion (issue 361: left/start/justify->flex-start, center->center, right/end->flex-end), so a centered card is fully centered. Item-eligible, so settable grid-wide or per-card.

--grid-item-icon-size.description: Icon size (width and height) of a card image when image_treatment is 'icon' — the fixed box the un-cropped icon renders in, above the title. No effect under the default 'banner' treatment (the 16:9 cover banner ignores it). Item-eligible, so settable grid-wide or per-card.
--grid-item-icon-size.conditionality_note: at least one item declares an image_url — the icon box IS that item's image wrapper

--grid-item-title-size.description: Card title font size. 1.14rem is the effective default at desktop (>=768px) on the default cards layout; below 768px it is 1.06rem, the featured first card takes 1.22rem at >=1024px, and a steps card takes 1.04rem.

--grid-item-text-color.description: Card description text color. var(--color-text-secondary) is the effective default at desktop (>=768px); below 768px it is var(--color-muted). DUAL JOB: it also colours the card BULLET text, and it overrides the preset colour of the meta and kicker text roles at every breakpoint — so this one slot governs the whole non-title body of the card, not just the description paragraph. Note the bullet list has no desktop tier of its own: UNSET, bullets stay var(--color-muted) at every viewport while the description paragraph lightens to var(--color-text-secondary) at >=768px. Setting the slot makes both surfaces agree.

--grid-item-bullet-color.description: Checklist bullet marker color (grid card bullets)

--grid-item-link-color.description: RESTING card link color. Its positional twin is --grid-item-link-hover-color: a colour set here and left unset there reverts to the default accent-hover under the pointer, so set both or neither.

--grid-item-link-hover-color.description: HOVER card link color — the positional twin of --grid-item-link-color, which owns the resting colour. The hover MUST stay visually distinct from rest: setting both to the same value erases the hover feedback on the card link.

--grid-step-bg.description: Step badge background (fill) color (steps layout). The numeral text color is a separate slot, --grid-step-text-color (default var(--color-bg)) — pair the two for a light fill with ink numerals

--grid-step-text-color.description: Step numeral (number text) color (steps layout). Defaults to var(--color-bg) so unset renders byte-identically; set it to an ink color when --grid-step-bg is a light fill (e.g. a lime badge) so the numeral stays high-contrast, mirroring the --cta-button-bg/--cta-button-color fill+ink pairing on buttons

dark-showcase.description: Dark background with light cards for product showcase

dense-cards.description: Tight card spacing for compact layouts

uniform-cards.description: Neutralize the featured first-card treatment for a uniform row: removes the top bars, the featured texture stripe, and the featured glow, and pins one shared border, background, shadow, and title size on every card. Residual differences that stay: the faint texture on cards 2+, a 0.25rem body padding-top difference on card 1 at desktop, and the dark-theme lift
